name: Mightstock
description: Seat the bolt in the groove and pass a thread of qi into the shaft to prepare it for charging.

name: Renewing Trigger
description: Hold the breath while qi gathers in the shaft so the charge builds evenly.

name: Verity Stirrup
description: Feel along the rail with qi to confirm the charged bolt rests true.

name: Glint Windlass
description: Loose a bolt whose shaft carries a faint charge so it flies flat and sure.

name: Grinding Cranequin
description: Loose a charged bolt so the stored qi drives the head through hide and light armour.

name: Daybreak Latch
description: Wrap the shaft in a tight sheath of qi so the charge does not leak before release.

name: Rumbletwang
description: Release a bolt holding stored qi so it punches through a shield and strikes the body behind.

name: Grinding Releaseclack
description: Hold the bolt for several heartbeats while the charge deepens and then loose it as one heavy blow.

name: Stock Tincture
description: Count the pace of the volley aloud so every shooter loosed in the same beat.

name: Tripbar Remedy
description: Link span and seat and aim into one unbroken motion that repeats without a pause.

name: Daybreak Bowprod
description: Swap an empty quiver for a full one at the hip without taking the eyes off the line.

name: Vital Sear
description: Keep the aim on the same patch of ground between shots so the volley stays tight.

name: Renewing Latch
description: Sweep a glance across the foe line to pick the next mark before the last bolt lands.

name: Intent Cranking
description: Hold a steady cycle of loosing so a stream of bolts keeps the foe from rising.

name: Silt Twang
description: Step to a new firing place between volleys so the foe cannot find the line.

name: Chime Twang
description: Tilt the bow high and loose so the bolts fall steeply onto the foe line.

name: Mayhem Setback
description: Keep the cycle of loosing going with qi in the arms so a long rain of bolts covers a wide patch.

name: Downpour Span
description: Loose the whole rank together with a pulse of qi in each bolt so the volley lands hard.

name: Renewing Windlass
description: Fix the eye on the hem of the foe's cloak as the mark for a pinning bolt.

name: Remnant Cranequin
description: Aim at the loose edge of a sleeve where cloth hangs clear of the arm.

name: Equipoise Boltrail
description: Seat a long flat-headed pin bolt made to hold cloth rather than cut flesh.

name: Gustspan
description: Loose a pin bolt through the hanging cloth of a foe so it sticks fast in the ground.

name: Quelling Stirrup
description: Pin the hem of a long coat to the earth so the wearer cannot stride freely.

name: Subduing Quarrel
description: Pin the cloth at the edge of a foe's shadow so the foe turns to free it.

name: Latchcuirass
description: Nail a sleeve to a post or tree with a short bolt so the weapon arm is held.

name: Suppressing Boltrail
description: Loose a quick spread of pin bolts so many foes find their clothing fixed to the ground at once.

name: Thorn Trigger
description: Drive a heavy bolt through the cloak or hide of a foe and deep into timber behind so the foe is held.

name: Equipoise Stock
description: Level the ground at the firing post with a spade so the stand does not shift.

name: Intentsear
description: Hang spanned spare bows on a rack at the post so each is within a reach of the shooter.

name: Vitalstock
description: Open the quarrel chest and fan the bolts so the heads point the same way.

name: Might Bowprod
description: Rest the bow rail on a bank of earth so the aim stays steady through a long wait.

name: Remnant Tripbar
description: Sight down the open lane in front of the post to learn where the foe must cross.

name: Waning Sear
description: Drive stakes along the lane to mark the distance of each firing point.

name: Ravaging Quarrel
description: Loose from the rested bow at a marked point so the bolt strikes with full force.

name: Daybreak Trigger
description: Drop an emptied bow and take up the next spanned one in a single motion.

name: Granite Sear
description: Sweep bolts along the length of the lane so no foe can cross without being struck.

name: Glintspan
description: Hold on a marked point and loose the moment a foe steps there so the bolt meets the foe.

name: Gusttwang
description: Loose one bow and let it fall and loose the next at once so bolts follow with no pause.

name: Boltrail Tincture
description: Listen for the order to move or hold or loose and obey it at once.

name: Mightlatch
description: Shift by a half step to keep the shoulder level with the neighbour on each side.

name: Daybreak Stock
description: Take the issued bolts and count them by touch so the quiver holds the right number.

name: Heartening Latch
description: Stand with the spanned bow low and the safety on while the company waits.

name: Latchlinctus
description: Unspan the bow and check the nut and the string when the company is dismissed.

name: Waningstock
description: Call the number of the file aloud so the caller knows each rank stands ready.

name: Splintering Setback
description: Loose along the whole line on the order so the foe meets a sheet of bolts.

name: Gustsear
description: Wheel the end of the line in step to bring the bows onto a flank.

name: Invigorating Cranequin
description: Pass an order down the line by voice and hand sign without breaking the loosing.

name: Vital Windlass
description: Span the bows of the reserve rank in unison so fresh bows are ready to rotate forward.

name: Twangbarrage
description: Loose the whole company together with qi in each bolt so the volley hammers a wide patch.

name: Silt Releaseclack
description: Retire the company rank by rank while the standing rank keeps loosing to cover the move.

name: Daybreak Stirrup
description: Pair one breath of the body with one breath of qi so both tracks keep time.

name: Vitallatch
description: Draw with both arms in equal measure so the string leaves the nut without a twist.

name: Tripbar Tincture
description: Hold the near sight and the far mark in one line and judge between them.

name: Hoarfrost Span
description: Loose on the second beat of a paired count so body and qi arrive at the same moment.

name: Iron Releaseclack
description: Loose a bolt with body force and qi force joined along one line to bore through a guard.

name: Mightsear
description: Span with body strength while qi seats the next bolt so the reload runs on two tracks.

name: Granite Bowprod
description: Take a step after each loose in a set pair of paces so the shooter never stays on one spot.

name: Glint Setback
description: Loose two bolts from a twin groove rail so the second follows the first into the same breach.

name: Mindful Cranequin
description: Move the force of the draw from the body track to the qi track mid cycle so the next loose lands harder.

name: Equipoise Sear
description: Take a narrow high stance on a ledge or branch with the weight over the rear foot.

name: Nursing Tripbar
description: Narrow the gaze to one distant spot and hold it until the whole mark stands clear.

name: Anointing Stirrup
description: Balance the two limbs of the prod by feel so the bow does not tip in the hands.

name: Intent Boltrail
description: Hover on a held breath with the body motionless for a long still moment before the release.

name: Vital Bowprod
description: Lean the body forward over the front foot to prepare a steep downward shot.

name: Blaze Quarrel
description: Loose from a height so the bolt falls in a steep line onto a mark far below.

name: Spanjaunt
description: Move from one perch to the next with a light qi step that makes no sound.

name: Veritysear
description: Sweep the gaze over the whole field from a high perch to find every foe at once.

name: Rumblesear
description: Loose from a high perch so a quarrel with stored qi falls steeply onto a mark and drives deep.

name: Cleaving Setback
description: Gather qi for a breath and loose two paired prods in a single beat at two marks.

name: Renewing Stock
description: Dig the heels into the basin bank so the stance holds on loose earth.

name: Anointing Trigger
description: Rest the bow rail on a flat river stone for a steady shot across the water.

name: Chimelatch
description: Use the line of the reeds on the far bank as a guide to the distance.

name: Intent Stirrup
description: Span to the slow count of the river so the draw never rushes.

name: Releaseclack Maelstrom
description: Loose from the bank rest across the water at a target on the far side.

name: Stockspurt
description: Cross a ford with the bow held high and the footing guided by a thread of qi.

name: Hollowsear
description: Lead a boat or a swimmer against the current and loose a bolt that meets the mark.

name: Tearing Quarrel
description: Hold a rank along the basin rim and loose in a steady stream across the crossing to pin foes.

name: Latch Elixir
description: Seat both cranequins on the paired strings and set the stock against the ground.

name: Might Cranequin
description: Turn both handles at the same rate so the two strings draw as one.

name: Chime Sear
description: Run a thumb over both strings to check they sit at the same height.

name: Intent Trigger
description: Wipe the rail clean of grit with a clean cloth before laying the bolt.

name: Equipoise Windlass
description: Lay two bolts side by side on the twin rail with the heads level.

name: Equipoise Bowprod
description: Pause between turns for one breath so the strain does not build in the arms.

name: Mindful Tripbar
description: Crank both strings back in one rhythm with qi in the legs so the next loose is ready soon.

name: Novasear
description: Loose both bolts from a double drawn bow so they strike the same mark one after the other.

name: Silt Quarrel
description: Pace sideways in step with the loader so the pair keep the same line.

name: Cranking Barrage
description: Loose a double drawn prod with qi in both limbs so a single heavy bolt pierces shield and armour.

name: Rousing Latch
description: Lock stored qi into both cranked limbs so the next loose carries it with no further effort.

name: Intentlatch
description: Plant the feet wide near the plateau edge with the knees soft against a hard gust.

name: Boltrail Linctus
description: Hold a sworn breath until the mark is fixed and the hands are still.

name: Perceptive Windlass
description: Watch a tied feather on the bow to read the strength of the wind.

name: Invigorating Trigger
description: Align the rail with a far landmark to take a clear bearing on the mark.

name: Sustaining Stirrup
description: Seat the sworn bolt in the groove and say its mark under the breath.

name: Stock Assault
description: Loose across a broad stretch of open plateau with the aim set against the crosswind.

name: Silt Cranking
description: Lean into a gust and step to keep the body upright and the bow level.

name: Remnant Stock
description: Hold the taken bearing in the mind through a gust so the aim does not drift.

name: Cranking Maelstrom
description: Swear a bolt to one mark and hold its qi until the aim is true and then loose it.

name: Spantorment
description: Loose steadily from the open edge so a stream of bolts keeps foes pinned on the slope below.

name: Remnant Latch
description: Take a bearing on the mark against a fixed landmark and fix it in memory.

name: Daybreak Windlass
description: Send the bolt away on the out breath so the release matches the body.

name: Heartening Sear
description: Read the lean of the grass and the cloak to judge the push of the gale.

name: Stockremedy
description: Brace the front foot against a stone at the edge to hold the stance in a gust.

name: Restoring Boltrail
description: Hold a cord stretched from the bow to a distant marker to keep the line true.

name: Waning Cranequin
description: Glance at the bending grass between the bow and the mark to see the gust.

name: Scything Cranking
description: Loose along the held bearing so the bolt follows the line to the mark.

name: Hastening Quarrel
description: Step to a new place while keeping the same bearing on the mark.

name: Intentstock
description: Steady the bow with qi through a gust so the held bearing does not sway.

name: Latchremedy
description: Take two bearings on the mark from two positions to fix its distance.

name: Facet Span
description: Send a charged bolt along the held bearing so it strikes the mark and breaks its guard.

name: Glint Twang
description: Loose high into a strong gale and trim the drift with qi so the bolt settles on a mark behind cover.

name: Vigorous Tripbar
description: Take the low open stance of the wind-sworn with the shoulder turned from the gust.

name: Vital Stirrup
description: Trim the fletching of each quarrel short so the gust cannot turn it in flight.

name: Stockelixir
description: Time the breath to the lulls between gusts so the hold is calm when the wind drops.

name: Discerning Boltrail
description: Sight along the ridge line to measure how far the mark stands from the bow.

name: Hoarfrost Setback
description: Loose in a lull with the sworn stance so the quarrel flies true across open ground.

name: Gust Bowprod
description: Step into the gap between gusts so each move comes when the wind is weak.

name: Stocklinctus
description: Read how far the thin high air lets a bolt fall and set the aim to suit.

name: Hollowtwang
description: Loose a sworn bolt that holds its line through a gust and pierces the guard of the mark.

name: Spanbarrage
description: Loose a close spread of sworn quarrels together so the hail lands across a broad stretch of ground.

name: Intent Tripbar
description: Set the feet on firm rock at the open edge with the body leaning slightly inward.

name: Gust Setback
description: Kneel at the lip of a drop to shoot down at a steep angle without being seen.

name: Verity Bowprod
description: Take sight across wide open sky where the horizon gives no guide to range.

name: Vital Trigger
description: Count slowly through the hold to keep the aim steady in a rising gust.

name: Searbarrage
description: Rest the bow on the stone of the edge and loose down onto a distant mark.

name: Torrent Span
description: Slide along the edge in short sure steps without losing the line to the mark.

name: Rupturing Setback
description: Drop a charged bolt from the open edge onto a mark far below so it drives deep.

name: Harrowing Cranking
description: Gather qi for a breath and loose a wide fan of bolts from the edge down onto the field below.
